data.name: BLOODPUNISHED: NO TIME POR PATIENCE
data.detailed_description:
BLOODPUNISHED is a precision platformer and horror game where every jump could be your last. Entirely hand-drawn in black and white ink, it tells the story — through the pages of a diary — of a victim's descent into madness, trapped in a place that won't let him go.

There is no margin for error. Every platform, every trap, and every second against the clock is designed to punish imprecision and reward mastery.

Key features:

  • Unforgiving precision platforming, built for players who crave a real challenge

  • Time-attack sequences that push tension to its limit

  • A world entirely hand-drawn in black and white, as if pulled from a nightmare

  • A story told through the protagonist's diary, page by page, as sanity unravels

  • A mystery that only reveals itself to those who survive long enough to see it
